4253826f25:
Hurry the adjustment of the Enhanced Humans.
Yazan, stand by on the mobile suit deck.
7a588703c2: Scirocco's mobile suit squad, dead ahead!?
dd3ac05010:
Heh heh... Scirocco, you've got some nerve.
Sounds like fun. I'm in!
You've got your reasons too, right?
fbc772850e:
People must be guided to something better.
They need an absolute ruler to lead them.
5548791d5d: ...When this battle is over, will people change?
f6b10a6856:
We will change them.
And the one to do it may be you, Reccoa.
f02808c70d:
A three-way battle, now joined by the Axis forces, was
raging over Gryps 2, the colony laser the Titans had
built as their trump card against the AEUG.
f8872b7154:
Having lost Gryps 2 to the AEUG,
the Titans prepared to take it back.
ff0508ebc9:
Scirocco, who had assassinated Titans leader Jamitov
for his own supremacy, set his sights on his next
target: Bask, the Titans' number two.
cc67a59835:
On Scirocco's orders, Reccoa killed Bask and his ship
in the chaos of battle. Yazan saw it, and knowing
Scirocco's ambitions, joined his rebellion.
9888bdbbd0:
With the Yazan Unit and all the Titans forces under
his command, Scirocco ordered an all-out attack
on the AEUG to retake Gryps 2.
d61fc2a9cf:
Scirocco, you treat war as a game! You'll never
understand this power that flows through my body!
17a06530d5:
Power that flows through your body...
As if such a thing could defeat a mobile suit!
97e93111eb:
If you still resist...!
...Then disappear from here!!
45e644f606:
Your very existence is a nuisance!
You must be able to see them!
The wills of the people who died in vain in battle!
0efed938a0:
As long as people live, they are alone! So is mankind!
As if all mankind could become Newtypes like you!
Before that, mankind will devour the Earth!
3474f3db82:
Can't you trust people that much!?
Understand that hatred only breeds more hatred!
263b23e0f0:
Kamille took the feelings of many people into his heart
and, together with their souls, defeated Scirocco.
f5ffe1ae0c:
But the price was far too high. Kamille's too-gentle
heart could not bear the weight, and Scirocco's dying
thoughts struck it a blow that shattered it.
d5d055ebb0:
Meanwhile, Haman and the Axis forces, who had read the
battle and withdrawn early, renamed themselves Neo Zeon
and rose in an Earth Sphere worn out by the Gryps War.
98c6cf3189:
The senseless conflicts of adults consumed by strife
drew in many children. Judau Ashta and his friends
were also victims of the war.
2353bf8387:
Living strong amid the flames of war, Judau
eventually awakened as a Newtype and, as the pilot
of the ZZ Gundam, faced Haman in a final battle.
456768fdba:
People's feelings, people's wills become power...
Touched by Judau's gentle feelings, Haman entrusted
the future of mankind to the children and fell in battle.
a3600f4db3:
After this battle... it came to light that Mineva,
heir to the Zabi family, had been missing since
the end of the Gryps War.
8072c4fe4f:
Amid the postwar chaos, Mineva had been
taken away by Quattro - by Char.
445dc0e6ea:
Mineva would not take the stage until much later,
after Char, who had vanished in the Gryps War,
resurfaced once more as an enemy of the Federation.
